card.text: The innermost of HR 8799's four imaged giants, 16 au out, found in 2010.

sources.quote: Here we report the presence of a fourth planet, interior to and about the same mass as the other three.

introduction.text: HR 8799 e is a young gas giant of about 7.4 Jupiter masses, 16 au from its star. One orbit takes about 53 years, near a 2:1 resonance with its neighbours.

color.title: JWST infrared colour
color.summary: Its 4.1 to 4.6 µm brightness from JWST as blue, green and red, on one scale with its siblings. One colour, not a map.
